name: benefit_none
description: No credit: AI tokens add no data

name: benefit_exp_size
description: Exponential window, also size-dependent ($R^\star=K t^\rho n^\sigma$)

name: ours
description: Exponential window, free $\eta$, $R^\star=K t^\rho$, harm $\gamma t^{u}n^{v}[\log(1+r)-r/(1+r)]$ on the data term (ours)

name: harm_logshare_constant
description: $\gamma\,[\log(1+r)-r/(1+r)]$ on the data term, no budget or size dependence

name: harm_logshare_budget
description: $\gamma t^{u}[\log(1+r)-r/(1+r)]$ on the data term, no size dependence

name: harm_logshare_size
description: $\gamma n^{v}[\log(1+r)-r/(1+r)]$ on the data term, no budget dependence

name: harm_logshare_additive
description: $\gamma t^{u}n^{v}[\log(1+r)-r/(1+r)]$ added to the loss, not tied to the data term

name: harm_log
description: $\gamma t^{u}n^{v}\log(1+r)$ on the data term (harm starts at the first AI token)

name: harm_boxcox
description: Box--Cox of $\log(1+r)$ with free curvature $\lambda$, on the data term

name: harm_power
description: Power law $\gamma r^{p} t^{u} n^{v}$ added to the loss \citep{lovelace2026prescriptive}
